game.workload: One Inventory open and close from the original Global Balanced lobby.

probe.treatment: Ordinary shell dumpsys meminfo -d with numeric PID, before and after the measured close.
probe.view: Fixed tap schedule from a fresh game process in one Android boot. No disk cache clearing.
probe.timing: SurfaceFlinger actual and ready timestamps and ordinary 100 ms /proc counters. Detailed memory calls bracketed with Android uptime.
probe.limits: Categories describe residency by state. Faulting addresses and within-pause mapping changes are outside the measurements.

excluded_attempts: An earlier control attempt encountered the daily sign-in promotion before any Inventory input.
The initial final-control attempt lost Windows foreground after opening Inventory and before the close tap.
The final-control retry lost Windows foreground while settling the Lobby, before any collector or Inventory input.
